text:
tina_sales (Sales): Orbitra wants a 3-week POC for a custom variant 'orca-compact-12b-q5'. Needs: reserved pricing for ~1M tokens/mo, Dedicated A100, session KV cache, Private VPC + BYO-KMS. Looping in @omar_ml @rylee_ops @neha_sec.

omar_ml (Eng-ML): Quick check: did they export with any fused ops or custom CUDA kernels? If yes we need the unfused checkpoint or the fused-op sources. Also what's their latency SLO and typical prompt lengths?

tina_sales (Sales): They want p95 <= 300ms. Prompts ~30 tokens, responses ~150 tokens. They said export used light fusion but not custom kernels — still will confirm.

omar_ml (Eng-ML): Good. For that SLO on A100 with q5 we can aim for int-like quant path with prefix_session KV. Example smoke config I’d run: 
```
model: orca-compact-12b-q5
precision: q5
hardware: a100-80gb
batching:
  latency_target_ms: 275
kv_cache: prefix_session
seq_max: 2048
```

omar_ml (Eng-ML): Ask them for a small checkpoint or model wheel and 30-50 validation prompts. If fusion turns out to include fused attention we may need a compat test or a rebuild (adds 2-4 business days).

rylee_ops (Solutions): Ballpark reserved economics: for similar 12B q5 variants on A100 we typically quote an effective $0.005-0.011 per 1k tokens depending on utilization and cache hit. I'll run exact math after perf results and concurrency profile.

neha_sec (Security): BYO-KMS + Private VPC supported. We'll need their KMS ARN, desired rotation cadence, and the completed security questionnaire. If they plan to send regulated data flag that.

tickets-bot: Ticket POC-8812 created: "oribtra-poc-staging" assigned to eng-ml and eng-infra. ETA: 48h.

tina_sales (Sales): I'll request the unfused checkpoint, 50 prompts, and concurrency trace (peak ~40?).

omar_ml (Eng-ML): Perfect. Once I have artifacts I'll run perf + a quick quality regression against a baseline and report any kernel/op fallbacks.

rylee_ops (Solutions): After Omar's perf numbers I'll produce a draft reserved pool recommendation and an estimated per-token rate within 48h.

tina_sales (Sales): Thanks team — I'll post uploads here when Orbitra replies.
